title: Splitting a conjunction
description: constructor splits the ∧ into two goals; rfl closes one, then the other.
source:
theorem and_split : 2 + 2 = 4 ∧ [1, 2, 3].length = 3 := by
  constructor
  · rfl
  · rfl

steps.explanation: The goal is a conjunction: we must prove both 2 + 2 = 4 and [1, 2, 3].length = 3.
constructor splits the ∧ into two separate goals, case left and case right, each proved on its own.
rfl closes the left goal, since 2 + 2 computes to 4. Only the right goal is left.
rfl closes the right goal too, since the list has three elements: proof complete.
